title: Mastering CAP Analysis: Assessing Classification Models with Accuracy Ratio

cues.en: Cap analysis we've talked about cap a lot.

cues.en: The red line which is our model line the and different models will have different red lines but basically look something like that.
cues.zh: 紅線是模型線，各模型紅線不同，但大致長這樣，

cues.en: And the gray line which is the perfect model or when you have a crystal ball when you can select all
cues.zh: 灰線是完美模型，或稱有水晶球的情況，能立刻挑出所有

cues.en: of the future turners or purchaser's or whatever action takers and you can select them right away on

cues.en: the dot before even selecting one single person that you don't want to select.

cues.en: And so these are the three main lines and how do we analyze this cap Kaveri know how to build it.

cues.en: But what can we derive what insights can we derive from here.
cues.zh: 能從中得到什麼洞見？

cues.en: Well it's kind of intuitive that the closer your red line is to the gray line the better you model the closer to the blue line the worse.
cues.zh: 直覺上，紅線越接近灰線，模型越好；越接近藍線，模型越差。

cues.en: So how can we quantify this effect.
cues.zh: 要怎麼量化這個效果？

cues.en: Well there is a standard approach to calculate the accuracy ratio and to calculate accuracy ratios you
cues.zh: 有個標準方式，計算準確比率。做法是

cues.en: take the area under the perfect model or the perfect line which is color in gray here and it's called a pea.
cues.zh: 取完美模型，也就是灰色完美線和隨機線之間的面積，這裡塗成灰色，叫 A_P，

cues.en: And then you need to take that area under the red line which is colored in red here which is a R and
cues.zh: 再取紅線與隨機線之間的面積，這裡塗成紅色，叫 A_R，

cues.en: then you need to divide one by the other.
cues.zh: 然後將兩者相除，

cues.en: So you need to divide a r by AP and then this ratio that you get is obviously between 0 and 1.
cues.zh: 也就是 A_R 除以 A_P，所得比率顯然介於 0 與 1，

cues.en: And the closer this ratio is to 1 the better the further it is away from one and close to zero the worse .
cues.zh: 越接近 1 越好，離 1 越遠、越接近 0，則越差。

cues.en: However it can be quite complicated to calculate this area under the curve statistical tools can do it for you.
cues.zh: 不過計算曲線下面積可能有點複雜，統計工具可以幫忙，

cues.en: But how can you assess the cap curve by just looking at it so visually it's not that easy to get this quantifiable metric just by looking at the curve.
cues.zh: 但光看曲線，如何評估 CAP？視覺上很難直接得到這個量化指標，

cues.en: So there's a second approach and that's what we're going to discuss.
cues.zh: 所以還有第二種方法，這就是接下來要談的。

cues.en: Now let's get rid of areas and instead of looking at the area what you can do is look at the 50 percent

cues.zh: 如果 X 介於 60% 到 70%，模型算差或普通。順帶一提，這是我自己的經驗法則，

cues.en: If your model is showing you results like 90 percent or save for Mulshine you 100 percent then the obvious answer there is that one of your independent variables is actually a post facto variable meaning that
cues.zh: 若模型顯示 90%，甚至 100%，很明顯可能是某個自變數其實是事後變數，也就是

cues.en: it shouldn't be in the data because it's looking into the future.
cues.zh: 它不該出現在資料裡，因為偷看了未來。

cues.en: The person who supplied you that variable forgot to take it out or forgot to explain to you that you
cues.zh: 提供變數的人忘記移除，或忘記解釋，

cues.zh: 所以得到 100% 當然要檢查，即使介於 90% 到 100%，也要確認是否存在這種前瞻未來的變數。
